headline: 'Heatflation' hits dining table prices… concerns that August inflation will rebound into the 3% range
summary: South Korea's consumer price inflation fell to 2.8% last month, entering the 2% range for the first time in eight months. Heat wave and Middle East war effects could push August inflation back toward 3%.
why: Consumer inflation shapes Bank of Korea policy decisions, which influence interest rates, the won and domestic bond yields.
